notes: v7.0.0 — Major Release: MV Platform Sub-Pages + AUTO Mode. (1) MV page split into three engine-specific sub-pages: Muse MV (blue/cyan), Suno MV (green/emerald), Melo MV (amber/orange) — each with its own AUTO mode. (2) MVPage.jsx refactored to accept engine/engineName props, removed MVEngineSelector in favor of fixed engine per page. (3) MV AUTO mode: 3-step confirmation modal, 60s countdown with creative thoughts at 50s/40s/20s/5s milestones, auto-generation loop with random genre/style/palette/effects, song count limit from autoConfig, incremental history saving (creation_draft → song/creation_attempt), AutoCreativePanel integration with engine-specific colors. (4) Navigation updated: MV is now a collapsible group in sidebar with 3 children (mv-muse, mv-suno, mv-melo), matching the music group pattern. (5) All existing MV functionality preserved: local generation, AI generation, video composition, timeline preview, AI tools grid, history panel, copy/download/share. (6) Engine-specific color theming applied to header, progress bar, tool cards, and AUTO countdown banner.
